scores.evidence: Every segment has its own visual anchor. 2-2 has the goal/feature definitions and the feature-to-goal table. The section shown as 2-3 has the MVP/MoSCoW definitions and the MoSCoW table. 2-4 has the 6-step procedure, the screen-flow diagram (図1 / Figure 1) and the prompt cards. The diagram labels are large, in the right language and readable at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-14.png, pages/desktop-jp-09.png, pages/desktop-en-10.png).

metrics.json lists no text-only screens in any locale. Desktop JP has a median of 37 chars per line (target 30–40) and EN a median of 71 (target 60–75). Prose sits between definition lists, tables, steps and checks, with no walls of text. Long quiz options wrap to 2 even lines on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-19.png, pages/mobile-jp-21.png) and on desktop EN (pages/desktop-en-13.png), and the option cards keep their spacing.

Both locales are fully localized, with no Japanese in the EN shots and no stray English in JP beyond the intended terms (MVP, MoSCoW, Must/Should/Could/Won't). Example: the q8 option '画面名と保存する項目名だけを、自分で決めて書き足す' (pages/desktop-jp-13.png) and 'Decide just the screen names and field names yourself, and add them' (pages/desktop-en-13.png). Contrast is fine, and on mobile the last options and the 答える buttons sit above the bottom bar (pages/mobile-jp-19.png, pages/mobile-jp-21.png). The diagram has an alt toggle ('図の説明を読む').

Static captures do not show feedback, explanations or flashcard backs, so their layout was not checked (pages/mobile-jp-23.png, pages/desktop-jp-15.png show the unanswered or front states).

summary: lessonHash is left out on purpose: I was not given one and have no shell to run review-scope.mjs --hash, so check-review.mjs will refuse this review until the author gives me the hash and re-runs me. For the same reason I could not get the scope or verifies line, so this is a full check (mode full) of the fresh published-lesson preview instead of a verify round. metrics.json is clean: no overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors, no text-only screens, and line lengths on target. I opened all 25 mobile-jp screens, all 16 desktop-jp screens and the desktop-en screens with figures, tables and questions, and found no clipping, overlap, untranslated text or controls hidden under the bars. I added no must-fix items, and the working-tree copy of the previous visual-qa review also has none.
